# The images the CI of qoryai's repositories pulls, copied to ghcr.io/qoryai/ci-images by
# .github/workflows/ci-images.yml: the same images under the same digests, every platform
# of each, for CI to pull them from there by digest, as
# ghcr.io/qoryai/ci-images:<tag>@sha256:<digest>, and not from Docker Hub or Amazon's copy
# of it, which refuse pulls made without a login from GitHub's shared addresses. The tag
# is for people to read; the digest is what is pulled.
#
# One image per line: the tag in ci-images, then the source, by digest. A pinned image
# stays as it is until its line is changed: to take a newer build, put the newer digest
# here, push, and then put it in the places that pull it.
